frontmatter.content: I work in first line with organizations to translate security needs, real-world attack patterns, and regulatory requirements into secure-by-design engineering practices — delivered through dedicated offensive security teams. 15+ years across software engineering and cybersecurity and contributor to European standardization, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)
